about_the_game:
Beat Overconfident Tokyo!

Unite the power of local pride and "hometown (jimoto: your local roots)" across the nation in this innovative action game!

Game Overview

Take control of the team led by Saitama Prefecture, joined by allies from across Japan.

Stages are set in carefully selected "hometowns (jimoto)" from Japan's 47 prefectures!

Navigate fields filled with familiar landmarks and local specialties!

The game rules are simple: jump and bounce to avoid falling off the stage and reach the goal.

It's a classic side-scrolling platformer.

However, your character is completely limp, making even walking a challenge.

The key to the game is mastering its unique controls.

Once you get the hang of it, you can even dash and perform big jumps. Give it a try!

Ally System

Clear stages to recruit new prefectures as allies!

They might help you by creating platforms or throw in unexpected challenges...

Harness the power of "hometowns" to pave the way to Tokyo's defeat!

Local Pride is Your Ultimate Weapon

Your attacks are powered by regional specialties! For example, Saitama wields Fukaya leeks, while Osaka throws takoyaki...

Use hometown pride to overcome stage obstacles and gimmicks.

Boss Battles with Local Trivia for Major Damage

During boss battles, answer quizzes about your local area to deal massive damage to Tokyo!

Packed with features that let you rediscover the charm of Japan while you play.

Step into the battle with local pride in your heart and beat Tokyo!

short_description: The citizens led by Saitama rise up in rebellion! The epic battle to defeat Tokyo begins now! Get hooked on the unique, wobbly limb controls! Dash through 3D-rendered "hometown (jimoto: your local roots)" worlds in this innovative platformer like no other!
